P1: Mt. Silver is a hallowed mountain that rises up between Johto and Kanto. These caves are home to powerful Pokémon, so only certain Trainers deemed up to the challenge are permitted to enter.
D2: Southern chamber; accessed via the cave opening near the middle of 1F (requires 冲浪, 攀瀑)
D3:
* Main chamber; west-central area, on a rock between the two waterfalls (hidden; requires 冲浪, 攀瀑, 攀岩)
* Northwest chamber; northeast corner of the upper level, on the rock wall (hidden; requires 冲浪, 攀瀑, 攀岩)
D4: Northwest chamber; northwest corner of the upper level, on the rock wall (hidden; requires 冲浪, 攀瀑, 攀岩)
D5: Main chamber; southeast area, on a lone rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D6: Main chamber (Northeast); partially obscured by a rock, accessed via Lower Mountainside (requires 攀岩)
D7: Main chamber; north-northeast area, on a lone rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D14: Highest level, west side, on the southernmost of three rocks (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D16: East; on a rock in the northeast corner, accessible via Upper Mountainside (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D17: East; east-central area, accessible via the northeast cave opening to Upper Mountainside
D19: North side, on a rock immediately to the left of the north exit (hidden)
D20: East side, on the second-highest level
D21: Southeast corner of the upper-most level, on a rock (hidden)
D22: South side, east end of the upper-most level (hidden)
D23: South side, west end of the upper-most level
D25: Upper level, on a rock to the east (hidden)
D27: Awarded to all Pokémon that participate in the battle against Red, after defeating him
P2: Use 冲浪 to move westward, then use 攀瀑 to climb the wall of water. Enter the nearby cave opening.
P3: The next area is a small, dead-end chamber. Pick up the 达人带 and return to 1F.
P4: Use 冲浪 again to sail northwestward and step onto dry land. Use 攀岩 to scale the wall and continue northward, then use the move again to climb down the other side. Continue northward to climb the second waterfall and enter the northern chamber. A legendary Pokémon roosts inside.
P5: The northwest chamber holds a deep pit, where a fiery bird Pokémon makes its roost. Use 攀岩 to reach the lower level and approach the legendary Pokémon.
P6: 火焰鸟 is the next member of the legendary birds. Begin with 水- and 电 attacks to wear its health down quickly, then follow up with 草, 火, 虫, 格斗, and 钢 moves to chip away at it even further. Consider inflicting status ailments like 睡眠 and 麻痹 to restrict its movements, and be sure to bring along some healing items as well.
P7: After the battle, either travel back to the entrance, or simply use an 离洞绳. Take a moment to visit the Pokémon Center if necessary, then use 攀岩 to scale the nearest wall and step out onto the mountainside.
P8: Go south to reach an 离洞绳, then follow the trail up the mountainside. Pick up 招式学习器76（隐形岩） from the south end of the uppermost level, then go north. Move down the first stairway and enter the nearest cave opening.
P9: Move northward to pick up a 全复药, then exit back to the mountainside.
P10: Continue down the mountainside, then go south and enter the cave opening on the middle level.
P11: Follow the upper-level path westward, then turn north. Climb up the large stairway and enter the cave opening in the north wall.
P12: This chamber houses a large, deep crater that forces travelers to wander in circles to reach the upper levels. Climb up the first two stairways to reach the middle level, then move in a counter-clockwise direction to reach a ＰＰ多项全补剂. Continue up to the second-highest level, then move clockwise to collect a 活力块. Climb the northwest stairway to the highest level; go south and use 碎岩 to reach a 特攻增强剂. Exit through the northern cave opening to reach the mountain's snow-covered heights.
P13: Move east around the corner, then enter the nearest cave opening.
P14: Go south to reach a 攻击增强剂, then exit back to the mountainside.
P15: Head south and enter the next cave opening.
P16: Move southward and exit through the next cave opening.
P17: Continue southward and turn the corner. Use 攀岩 to collect the 洁净薰香, then return to the southeast cave opening.
P18: Go west and take the next exit back to the mountainside.
P19: Use 攀岩 to scale the wall. From this location, there are three more points nearby with steps carved into the cliff. Climb the western path to reach a 觉醒之石, then backtrack and follow the middle path up to enter the cave opening on the highest level.
P20: Follow the tunnel westward and climb the towering cliffside. Step through the exit to reach the icy mountaintop.
P21: Cross over the narrow, snow-covered ridge to finally meet 赤红, former Champion of the Kanto region. He and his Pokémon have been in training here since he gave up his Champion title, and that training has resulted in each of his Pokémon reaching sky-high levels. Even with a type advantage, Red's Pokémon will not go down without a fight.
P22: A hailstorm blows in as the battle begins. The falling bits of ice will damage all non-冰 Pokémon each turn, except those with certain Abilities.
P23: 赤红 leads with his first partner, 皮卡丘. As it has reached an incredible level 88, it is not an opponent to be underestimated. As if it was not dangerous enough on its own, the 电气球 it holds doubles the power of each of its moves. 地面 Pokémon are best here, as they are immune to 电 moves, and Pikachu takes serious damage from Ground attacks.
P24: At level 80, 拉普拉斯 is Red's lowest-leveled Pokémon. Due to the hailstorm blowing over the battlefield, the accuracy of its 暴风雪 move is boosted to 100%. 精神强念 may cut the target's 特防, increase the damage it sustains. Use 格斗-, 岩石-, 草-, and 电 attacks to chip away at its high HP. Physical moves are most effective, as they target its weaker physical 防御.
P25: 卡比兽 has a massive amount of HP. Its high physical 攻击 lets it inflict a good deal of damage with 咬碎, which may lower the target's physical 防御. A stat drop like this can quickly become a nightmare for a target hit by 终极冲击. Snorlax is immune to 幽灵 attacks, and only takes serious damage from 格斗 moves.
P26: His 妙蛙花 can lull the target to sleep with 催眠粉, and sap its HP for its own with 终极吸取. 疯狂植物 is a massively powerful move that forces the user to recharge on the next turn. A 草 Pokémon, it fares poorly in extreme heat or cold, so use 火 and 冰 moves to wear it down.
P27: Though 喷火龙's physical 攻击 is lower than its 特攻, 闪焰冲锋 is still a powerful move that inflicts recoil damage and may 灼伤 the target. Like Venusaur's Frenzy Plant, 爆炸烈焰 is such a powerful attack that it forces the user to recharge after using it. Charizard takes massive damage from 岩石 attacks, but is also vulnerable to 水- and 电 moves.
P28: 水箭龟 is a more defensive Pokémon than the others, but should still not be taken lightly. 暴风雪 hits with 100% accuracy, and gives it a way to counterattack against 草 Pokémon. Both 真气弹 and 加农光炮 may cut the target's 特防. This lets it deal even more damage with 加农水炮, the 水 version of Frenzy Plant and Blast Burn. Blastoise falters against Grass and 电 attacks, and its lower physical 防御 means that physical moves are most effective.
P29: After the battle, 赤红 pauses for a moment in stunned silence. Then, in the blink of an eye, he disappears. He is not gone for good though, as defeating the Elite Four and Champion again will cause him to reappear here. The credits roll for the second time, and you resume your adventure back home in 若叶镇.
P30: Having scaled the mountain and defeated the legendary Trainer, the final remaining task is to complete the Pokédex. There are currently 493 known species, so there is plenty of training left to do!
